scholarships.title: IE University Master's Awards and Scholarships

eligibility: Admitted, or applying, to an IE University master's programme
IE Awards: assessed on both merit and financial need; 'financial need is considered—particularly for high-potential candidates with limited access to alternative funding'
IE Foundation Scholarships: 'Be sure to review the specific eligibility criteria, deadlines, and application requirements for each scholarship and award'
Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a favourable resolution
Some IE Foundation Scholarships require an additional scholarship-specific essay in the 'Additional Documentation' section of the IE Financial Aid Application
existing.eligibility_summary: Admitted candidates across all IE University master's programmes. IE Awards are assessed on both merit and financial need, with financial need considered particularly for high-potential candidates with limited access to alternative funding. IE Foundation Scholarships have award-specific eligibility criteria set by each partner organisation.
benefits: Direct Awards: merit-based awards granted automatically upon admission
IE Awards: tuition-fee coverage of between 10% and 40%
IE Foundation Scholarships: partner-funded awards with individual eligibility criteria, deadlines and application requirements
coverage: Tuition fees (10%–40% of tuition for IE Awards)
requirements: Submit the IE Financial Aid Application for IE Awards — 'All IE Awards require the submission of a financial aid application'
Review each IE Foundation Scholarship's specific criteria, deadlines and application requirements
Upload any scholarship-specific essay under 'Additional Documentation'
documents: Supporting documents uploaded through the application
Scholarship-specific essay in the 'Additional Documentation' section where the named award requires it
application_method: Direct Awards: automatic, 'no separate financial aid application is required', considered as part of the admissions process
IE Awards: submission of the IE Financial Aid Application, assessed on merit and financial need
IE Foundation Scholarships: award-specific applications, some via the IE Financial Aid Application
existing.selection_notes: 'For opportunities requiring an application, financial need is considered—particularly for high-potential candidates with limited access to alternative funding. Please note that meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a favorable resolution.'
existing.best_fit: Candidates admitted to any IE University master's programme who need help with tuition fees, either through automatic merit consideration or through a named IE Foundation Scholarship with partner-specific criteria.
existing.notes: The official page does not publish the euro value of any award, only the coverage range of 10% to 40% of tuition fees for IE Awards, and it does not publish a single calendar deadline. Loans and other financing options are published separately at /financial-aid/masters/loans-financing-options/.
existing.duration: One admission cycle; awards are assessed together with the admission decision.
existing.application_period: Aligned to each master's programme's admission and start dates; IE Awards close on the programme start date.
existing.deadline_display: There is no standalone scholarship call: Direct Awards are granted automatically upon admission, and 'The application deadline for IE Awards is the program start date.' Individual IE Foundation Scholarships carry their own deadlines.
existing.program_type: Merit-based tuition awards and merit-plus-need tuition awards for admitted master's students
